reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was "200 mg, no magnesium oxide" and the QR batch report from a named ISO 17025 lab, which is exactly what I check before buying. A dollar a day is fine, and a sachet in my gym bag works better than a bottle I forget on the counter.
objection: It is a brand I have never heard of, and I will not know if I actually sleep better or get fewer cramps until I have finished a whole box. I would also open the QR report before paying to see if it is a real lab report.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR batch report turned out to be fake or showed magnesium content well below 100 mg per capsule, I would not buy.
